messages.text: Heads up: the independent validation team sent over the draft findings on the RiskEngine VaR model this morning. Three items rated medium, one high. Worth a read before Friday's model risk committee.
Just skimmed it. Is the high one the backtesting exceptions? I remember we had a cluster of them in the August vol spike.
Yep. 6 exceptions at 99% over the trailing 250 days, which puts us in the yellow zone. They want a documented root cause, not just 'market was weird'.
Question on the medium findings: do we know if the proxy mapping issue is about the illiquid credit positions or the equity options? The wording in section 4 is vague.
Credit side, I think. They flagged that some thinly traded bonds get mapped to a sector index with stale spreads. I can pull the list of affected positions if that helps.
That would help a lot, thanks Lance. I'll cross-check against what PositionStore shows as of last close.
Also noticed they want evidence that the lookback window parameter change in July went through formal change approval. I only see the ticket, no sign-off attached.
Good catch Phillip. I approved it verbally in the weekly but you're right, nothing in writing. I'll add a retroactive approval note and flag it as a process gap rather than hide it.

For the root cause, I ran a quick comparison. Most exceptions line up with days where the intraday price snapshot was taken before the open auction settled. So it's partly a timing issue in how PricingSvc feeds the engine.
Interesting, that's a stronger story than model misspecification. Can you write it up with the specific dates and the P&L deltas? Validators will want to reproduce it.
Will do. Should have a draft by end of day tomorrow.
Separate point: ReportingBI still shows the old VaR methodology label on the regulatory dashboard. If validation sees that, it'll look like we're running two versions.
Ugh, yes. That's a label only, the numbers come from the current engine output. I'll ask Technology to update the dashboard text and confirm.
Please do, and screenshot before and after so we have an audit trail.
List is ready: 14 bonds mapped to the stale sector index, about $38M notional combined. I put it in the shared validation folder.
Got it. 11 of the 14 match PositionStore, and I'll chase down the other 3, probably matured or rolled.
Nice progress, everyone. Let's sync at 10 tomorrow to agree on management responses so we can submit them ahead of the committee.
